## Sparse-marker line fill (observed in task-096cc299)

Demos show a uniform background (demo: 2, markers: 1; another: 1/7; test: 9/0) with a third color (demo output: 3). Preserve all original marker cells and background cells not changed by the rule. For each row, sort the marker positions and fill every background cell strictly between each consecutive pair of markers with 3. The fill is only axis-aligned; do not extrapolate beyond the first/last marker, and don't fill diagonal spaces. Markers remain their original color. Equivalently: for every pair of consecutive same-marker cells in any row or column, color the gap with 3. In overlaps, still 3.

## Horizontal right-tail recoloring (observed task-705b0a10)

Across the demonstrations, recolor to 1 the right-side tail of the unique horizontal pattern row, keeping all other cells and rows unchanged.
